spec: Standalone contract, no ETH, no payable or receive, no deposits, no approvals. Windows of 6 hours by . enter(): one free entry per address per window, at most 256 entrants per window; entry weight = 1 + consecutive prior windows entered, capped at 5. After a window ends anyone calls draw(), which records the next block number; finalize() after that block uses its blockhash as seed (window voided if more than 256 blocks passed) and picks up to 5 distinct winners by weighted selection; each winner gets +1 point on a permanent on-chain board. Views: current window, entrants, winners per window, points. Only the Safe can pause entering. Gates: fuzz the weighted selection, invariants that winners are distinct entrants of that window and no points without a finalized draw, gas bound with full entrants. (a game build)
